description: Scope-mismatched lints are skipped (no finding recorded). Kind-mismatched lints produce NotApplicable findings. The doc comment says 'Lints that do not apply return NotApplicable findings' which is false for scope mismatches. Fix: clarify doc: 'Lints whose scope() does not match are skipped entirely. Lints in scope but whose applies_to() does not match produce NotApplicable.' File: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs lines 633-636.
title: pkix-lint: LintRunner::run_cert scope-skip vs kind-skip behavior inconsistency in docs
